description: Read-side catalog record describing a government agency observable from the public domain. Authored by L4 ingest scripts (`70-tools/scripts/gov/`) and/or by `com.etzhayyim.gov` Pregel-cell submissions; consumed by L3 appview routing. Constitutional framing per ADR-2605192100 §1.12 + ADR-2605242330: the religious-corp catalogs the state's structure for read-side interop without taking dependency on it. Replaces the etzhayyim-side `com.etzhayyim.apps.gov.agency` + `vertex_gov_official_agency` table (Kysely → MST, per ADR-2605212100). The `cofog` field aligns with `60-apps/etzhayyim-project-cofog/appview/` actor bundles.

name.description: Canonical English-language agency name. Title case, no abbreviation. Example: 'Ministry of Justice'.

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code (lowercase). Subnational jurisdictions use `{iso3}-{subcode}` form (e.g. `usa-ca` for California, `jpn-13` for Tokyo). Multi-jurisdiction bodies use ISO/IGO codes (e.g. `un`, `eu`, `asean`).

branch.description: Constitutional branch the agency belongs to.

cofog.description: UN COFOG (Classification of Functions of Government) code, dotted form. Example: '03.10' for police services, '08.40' for religious community services. Cross-references `60-apps/etzhayyim-project-cofog/appview/cofog-{code}-{country}-*`.

parentAgencyDid.description: DID of the parent agency if this is a sub-bureau. Resolves to another `com.etzhayyim.gov.agency` record.

establishedAt.description: ISO-8601 establishment date. Year-only resolutions encode as `YYYY-01-01T00:00:00Z`.

legalBasis.description: Citation of the founding law / decree / treaty / executive order. Format: `<jurisdiction>:<corpus>:<id>` where corpus is e.g. `law` / `ordinance` / `decree` / `executive-order` / `treaty`. Example: `jpn:law:法務省設置法`.

websiteUri.description: Canonical public website URI. https only.

agencyDid.description: Optional canonical DID of the agency itself if independently DID-rooted (e.g. `did:web:etzhayyim.com:gov:jpn:moj`). Read-only mirror — does not assert agency consent.

createdAt.description: Record creation timestamp (record author's clock; not the agency's establishment date).
